name: Marozi
description: A reported small, highland-dwelling lion of East Africa with retained leopard-like spots into adulthood and a reduced or absent mane. Two specimens were shot in the Kenyan Aberdares in 1931 but no living example or accepted subspecies has been confirmed.
origin: Reports concentrated in the Kenyan central highlands — particularly the Aberdare Range, the Mau Escarpment edge, and the Kinangop Plateau — with neighbouring reports from highland Tanzania, Uganda, and the Virunga / Rwanda border (sometimes treated as the related ikimizi and ntararago).
